item: Generator air filters matched to each generator model
rationale: A generator seized on Day 4 and the root cause was a long-overdue oil change; its air filter had not been changed since 2009. The brief's lesson is to include matched air filters in the pre-mission spare parts kit and service all generators on arrival.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 500-505, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 69 ('correct air filters per model')
